column1: # The blocking gate's selections (dev/block.jl, `bash dev/gate.sh --block`; L194). `core`: the smoke
# groups every landing runs. `probes`: the probe core (`-` while test/probe_corpus.jl holds none).
# `<file><TAB><groups><TAB><QA families><TAB><1.13 groups>`: a changed file's groups beyond the core,
# the QA families the gate's tests stage runs for it, and the smoke groups it runs on Julia 1.13;
# `-` for none (a directory row, ending in /, covers its files; the longest match wins). A changed
# file under src/, or a changed test file no stage runs and no QA family is, with no row fails the
# gate. `measured`: the src tree the map was written for; a change to src/ fails the gate when more
# than 8 pieces of src it alters moved since (dev/block.jl STALE_PIECES), when this repository does
# not hold that tree, or when a changed line of code lies in no piece. The rebuild's map is written
# by hand: every case runs the one compile entry, which the core covers, until WasmTarget lowers code
# a measurement can cover (dev/MARCH.md 1.D). Every group still runs on the full matrix.
